_excluded_by_date.note: These entries were in the upstream catalogue and are removed here, not merely hidden. Each claims Public Domain but was published from 1930 onwards, so copyright in the United States runs from publication and they are still protected there. gbible.taxonomy.pd_dated_ok refuses them, and the 'Licence gate' self-test fails if they reappear here.
